description: Track a Lezzoo order live — status, ETA, driver name/status/location, merchant, destination, and the ordered items (name, description, quantity, price, chosen options, image) — rendered as a status card with a progress stepper (and a map when the driver's live position is available). Pass an order_id, or omit it to track the customer's most recent active order. Requires sign-in. Read-only. Call again to refresh.

orderId.description: Order id to track. Omit to track the most recent active order.

name: track_order

driver.description: Driver info, or null before assignment.

items.description: Ordered lines: product_id, name, description, quantity, price (unit, incl. options), line_total, image, options [{name, values:[{name, price}]}], instructions.

tracking.description: null when there is no active order to track.

title: Track an order
